title: Night Striker S
overview:
Tear through the darkness of the giant city!!

The "Intergray" races through a giant city shrouded in darkness. It is a combat machine that speeds along like a car when touching the ground and can also fly. Tear through the darkness and push forward to annihilate the giant enemies lurking in the city!!

巨大都市の闇を切り裂け！！

闇につつまれた巨大都市を駆け抜ける「インターグレイ」。地面と接しているときは車のように疾走し、飛行も可能な戦闘マシンだ。都市にひそむ巨大な敵を殲滅すべく、闇を切り裂き突き進む！！
